transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'd like to get our launch-readiness meeting started for the new team-provisioning workflow. We know the workflow has passed functional, accessibility, and staging integration tests, and we have 200 eligible accounts in the production base. The draft plan proposes enabling it for 10% of eligible accounts across standard production regions next Tuesday. Before I settle the production feature-flag configuration, I need to hear from both the customer-success lead and the platform-capacity lead with their formal review findings. Could we start with those?

I confirmed with legal this morning that Northstar and Pine are covered by a pilot addendum requiring seven calendar days of customer notice before either account is enabled, and neither account has opted in. I haven't updated the launch ticket yet because legal confirmed the wording during a separate renewal review, but this means neither Northstar nor Pine should be included in next Tuesday's enablement cohort.

transcript.text: Before we settle the configuration, I need to disclose my platform-capacity finding. While reviewing an unrelated queue-capacity graph today, I measured that the provisioning service can safely handle exactly 12 new-account activations in us-east during the next Tuesday window. The draft plan proposes 10% of 200 eligible accounts, which is 20 accounts across multiple regions — that would exceed the safe queue limit I measured. I have not filed this capacity note yet, but it directly affects what we can safely enable next Tuesday.
